name: pb-runner
description: Your running coach, both ways: ChatGPT reads your runs and recovery from Garmin, Apple Watch, iPhone or Android, then writes your next session to your watch.

interface.shortDescription: AI running coach for your runs
interface.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your running data and use it as your running coach. PB-Runner works with Garmin, Apple Watch, iPhone and Android. Link Garmin Connect in the PB-Runner app and your Garmin runs arrive by themselves, or record with PB-Runner on your Apple Watch, iPhone or Android phone. On iPhone, runs from other apps can also come in through Apple Health.

Ask "Analyze the splits of my last run" and ChatGPT reads the splits, pace and heart rate, plus running power and form. Ask "Check my recovery before today's tempo" and it reads your sleep, heart-rate variability and resting heart rate from Apple Health or your Garmin, alongside your recent training load. Ask "Put an interval session on my watch for Thursday" and it drafts the session, shows it to you, and saves it when you say yes. Saved sessions appear in the PB-Runner app's Schedule, play on your Apple Watch, your phone or the PB-Runner Garmin watch app with live cues, and can go straight to your Garmin Connect calendar.

You stay in control. ChatGPT reads your training when you ask, and it changes your schedule, your profile or your logged runs only after you confirm a draft in the conversation.

You sign in with Apple or Google, and Garmin is linked through Garmin's own sign-in, so PB-Runner never sees your Garmin password. You choose what Apple Health and Garmin share. ChatGPT never receives your GPS routes or coordinates, and PB-Runner only reads and writes the training data of the account you sign in with.

Get the PB-Runner app on the App Store and Google Play, and sign in here with the same Apple or Google account you use in the app.
capabilities: Read your runs, splits, pace and heart rate from Garmin, Apple Watch, iPhone or Android
Read recovery: sleep, HRV and resting heart rate, from Apple Health or Garmin
Read personal bests, goal progress and race predictions
Draft training sessions and save them when you confirm
Saved sessions play on your watch or phone with live cues, and can go straight to your Garmin Connect calendar

Analyze the splits of my last run.
Check my recovery before today's tempo.

positive.prompt: How did my last run go?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the most recent run's distance, pace, splits and heart rate in the account's units, without inventing values.

positive.prompt: How's my recovery looking this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads resting heart rate, sleep and HRV against the account's own baseline; any missing value is described as not recorded, never as zero.
Lists the best times per distance with the date and run each came from.

positive.description: Draft and save a session after confirmation
positive.prompt: Put an easy 5 km run on my schedule for tomorrow.
positive.tools_triggered: get_athlete_profile, get_coach_note, get_recovery_context, get_planned_schedule, propose_planned_sessions, commit_planned_sessions
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the drafted session and asks for confirmation; calls commit_planned_sessions only after the user says yes, then confirms it is saved to the schedule.

positive.prompt: How do I play a planned session on my Apple Watch?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the get_help article for guided runs on the watch, using the app's real screen names.

review.commerce_description: PB-Runner does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.
